goals: Verify that AsyncWorkflowAESLambda successfully processes and saves an AES transaction when provided with valid inputs.
Verify that AsyncWorkflowAESLambda throws a NullPointerException when executed with a null event message or a null context.
activities: Mock the AES transaction factory to return the test transaction
Run the async workflow AES lambda with the transaction's account event message and mock context
Verify that the transaction is saved in the transaction table
Assert that a NullPointerException is thrown when running the lambda with a null message
Assert that a NullPointerException is thrown when running the lambda with a null context
